meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按你说的操作真实浏览器：打开网址、点击或填写网页元素、滚动、截图，并读取页面文字与元素状态。
howto.when: 当你说要“打开某个网址”“填写表单”“截图”等网页操作时，Claude 会调用浏览器来做。

say.note: 会启动浏览器打开该网站并保存截图。

say.text: 在这个登录页填上 user@test.com 和密码 123456，然后点登录
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框填入并提交表单。

say.text: 取一下这个页面的标题和所有链接
say.note: 会输出页面标题和找到的链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate a real browser per your request: open URLs, click or fill page elements, scroll, take screenshots, and read page text or element states.
howto.when_en: When you say things like "open this URL", "fill this form", or "take a screenshot", Claude launches the browser to do it.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude opens the URL and saves a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill the login form with user@test.com / 123456 and click submit.
say_en.note: Claude fills the fields and submits the form.

say_en.text: Get the page title and all links.
say_en.note: Claude outputs the title and link elements.
